summary: Skratch showcases top-performing team compositions for the Crown Contest Lightning Fortress boss in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. He compares Toxin, Dauntless, and Aura elemental setups, detailing gear synchronization, positioning, and skill timing. Toxin teams led by Serpentemis with Lothair or Twitch consistently achieve 5B to 7B+ damage. Skratch highlights the impact of the exclusive hero Holfast in Aura teams, demonstrating a 1 billion damage increase over older variants.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Provides over 1 billion additional damage when slotted into Aura team compositions.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Pushes Toxin team damage past 7 billion when paired with Serpentemis.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Effective alternative to Lothair, scoring over 5 billion damage in Toxin comps.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.note: Extremely powerful option for high-scoring boss challenges if owned.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Essential core hero for maximizing Toxin team damage output.

teams.note: Primary Toxin setup delivering 7.3B+ damage; Lothair can be swapped for Twitch for 5.3B+ damage.
Dauntless team composition scoring roughly 3.2B damage.
High-tier Aura team producing over 5.5B damage with Holfast.

meta_changes: Toxin and Aura teams dominate the Crown Contest Lightning Fortress rankings.
Dauntless compositions have dropped in relative efficiency compared to previous seasons.
Exclusive hero Holfast substantially elevates the damage ceiling for Aura team builds.
tips: Substitute Lothair with Twitch if you lack materials or the hero to achieve 5B+ Toxin damage.
Position heroes carefully so aura-buffing mythical gear pieces cover the entire team.
Sync equipment sets and skill timings when testing hero swaps to isolate true damage differences.
title: USE THESE Teams For Crazy Damage! Crown Contest Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
